data.name: Solar Flare
data.description:
She is the hero version of the Sunflower, a famous recurring plant character in the Plants vs. Zombies series, who in turn is based on the common Sunflower (Helianthus annuus).

Her fiery form and ability of flight are based on the Marvel Comics character Human Torch, with her enthusiastic personality being based on the Johnny Storm incarnation. Her fiery form may also allude to the Fire Flower from the Garden Warfare series.

Her name is a combination of "solar," a term relating to the sun, and "flare," a sudden brief burst of bright flame or light, which in turn may refer to "solar flare," a brief eruption of intense high-energy radiation from the sun's surface. Her name could probably be an allusion to the DC Comics character Starfire, or a reference to the Solar Flare Beam, an ability for the Sunflower in Garden Warfare series as well.

Powers:
- Sunburn: Her signature move. 
- Weed Whack
- More Spore
- Button Mushrooms
- Scorched Earth

Other facts:
- She can emit fire from her head, as seen when she uses a non-signature superpower.
- She has unseen parents that's working in the overseas.
- She got her powers from getting engulfed into flames by big fire dragons.
- When blocking, she will sometimes laugh in a mocking tone.
